Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Class SellerOfferService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.services.SellerOfferService
public class SellerOfferService extends Object
Task 2.5 Manage Offers & Requests: the seller's inbox of the price offers, borrow requests and claims made on their listings, and the four actions the use case gives them (Manage Offers & Requests 3.3-3.6).
  • Accept - DealRules.accept(com.hkust.marketplace.models.Offer) does the cross-role work: the offer becomes Accepted, the listing Reserved or Lent, every other open offer is declined with a notification, and the buyer is told.
  • Decline - only an open (Pending or Countered) offer; the buyer is notified.
  • Counter - only a Pending price offer or borrow request (A3: a claim cannot be countered); the terms are validated (A4) and the buyer is notified.
  • Open chat is the shared ChatService.openForOffer(java.lang.String), called by the screen.

Every method checks that the logged-in user is a seller and that the offer is on one of that seller's listings, so a seller cannot act on someone else's offer.

    • counterPrice

      public void counterPrice(String offerId, String typedPrice)
      Counters a pending price offer with another price (3.5) and tells the buyer, who answers by making a new offer (UC5 Special Requirement 4). The price is exactly what the seller typed: untrusted input, parsed at the barricade with Amounts.parse(java.lang.String), so digits with up to two decimals ("150", "99.50") pass and "abc", "1e3", "-5" or "1,000" are refused with the same message as a non-positive price (Manage Offers & Requests A4).
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if the offer cannot be countered or the price is not a plain positive amount

    • counterBorrow

      public void counterBorrow(String offerId, LocalDateTime start, LocalDateTime end)
      Counters a pending borrow request with other dates (3.5, A4) and tells the buyer.
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if the offer is not a pending borrow request, a date is missing, the start is in the past, or the period is shorter than the minimum borrow time
